spans.s: Mada (“intoxication,” personif.), an Asura. § 405 (Sukanyop.): III, 124, 10389 (kṛtyā…mahāsuraḥ, created by Cyavana, description); 125, 10396 (frightened Indra), 10403 (was distributed in drinks, women, dice, and hunting), 10404.--§ 772n (Cyavana): XIII, 157, 7317 (o: Cyavana created M. (description) as an enemy of Indra), 7320, 7322 (was distributed in dice, hunting, drinks, and women).--§ 772p (Kapa, pl.): XIII, 158, 7327, 7329.-§ 778b (Samvartta-Maruttīya): XIV, 9, †251 (Asuraṃ, description, all. to § 405). Cf. Asura, Dānava.
Madadhāra, a king(?). § 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1083 (mahīdharaṃ (a mountain?), vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya in the east). Cf. Mahīdhara.
Madana^2 = Śiva (1000 names^2).

Madayantī, wife of king Kalmāshapāda (Mitrasaha, Saudāsa). § 188b (Pāṇḍu): Commanded by her husband, M., the wife of Saudāsa Kalmāshapāda obtained from the ṛshi Vasishṭha the son Aśmaka (cf. § 229): I, 122, 4736.--§ 229 (Vasishṭhop.): I, 182, 6910 (on account of his being himself cursed, Kalmāshapāda caused M. to go to Vasishṭha, who begat a son on her, cf. § 188b).--§ 677 (Mokshadh.): XII, 235, 8604 (having given M. to Vasishṭha, Mitrasaha ascended to heaven; C. has by error Damayantīṃ). --§ 767 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 137, 6262 (do.).--§ 784b (Uttaṅka): XIV, 57, 1680; 58, 1695, 1708 (Uttaṅka obtained the ear-rings of M.).
Madgura (“pearl-fisher”), name of a caste: XIII, 2583 (dāsaṃ nāvopajīvanaṃ).
Madirā, one of the wives of Vasudeva. § 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 7, 194.

Madirāśva^1 = Madirāksha, the brother of Virāṭa. § 561 (Yānasandhip.): V, 57, 2237 (ºpurogamāḥ, have joined Yudhishṭhira, only C., B. has Madirākshaº).--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 171, 5907 (among the rathas of the Pāṇḍavas).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 184 (slain).

Madirāśva^2, an ancient king. § 677 (Mokshadh.): XII, 235, 8608 (rājarshiḥ, by having given his daughter to Hiraṇyahasta, M. went to regions praised by the very gods).-§ 720b (Sudarśanop.): XIII, 2, 91 (son of Daśāśva), 92 (father of Dyutimat).--§ 767 (Ānuśāsanik.): 137, 6268 (= XII, 8608).
Madirāksha, brother of Virāṭa. § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 31, 1012 (Śatānīkād avarajaḥ); 32, 1057 (in the rear of the army of Virāṭa); 33, 1106. Cf. Madirāśva.

Madra^1, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 190d (Arjuna): I, 123, 4796 (will be vanquished by Arjuna).--§ 234 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 190, 7092 (Śalyo Mºāṇām īśvaraḥ).--§ 285 (Nakula): II, 32, 1196 (Śākalaṃ…Mºāṇāṃ puṭabhedanaṃ).--§ 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1870 (º-Kaikayāḥ, brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira, B. has Bhº).--§ 545 (Pativratāmāhātmyap.): III, 293, 16620 (ruled by Aśvapati).--§ 581 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 61^3, 2691 (saha Kaikayaiḥ, in the army of Duryodhana, attack Arjuna and Abhimanyu).--§ 582 (do.): VI, 71^10, 3132 (º-Sauvīra-Gāndhāraiḥ, supported Śakuni), (), 3138 (ºāṇām ṛshabheṇa, sc. Śalyena).--§ 583 (do.): VI, 75, 3295 (-Sauvīra-Kekayaiḥ, followed Bhagadatta).--§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 7, 183 (in the rear of Droṇa's array).-§ 590 (do.): VII, 15, 613 (ºāṇām adhipaṃ, i.e. Śalya).-§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 20, 799 (º-Kaikayāḥ, in the neck of Droṇa's gāruḍavyūha).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 95, 3529 (ºāṇām īśvaro Śalyaḥ).--§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstramokshap.): VII, 193, 8903 (do.):--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 9, 331 (ºāṇām adhipaḥ, i.e. Śalya).-§ 605 (do.): VIII, 11, 418 (Śalyaḥ…mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ Mºdeśasamutthayā). 22, 864 (attacked the Pāñcālas).--§ 607 (do.): VIII, 44, 2070 (º-Gāndhārāḥ, among the peoples who have blameable practices); 45, 2086 (sg.), 2093 (ºstriyaḥ, are the most debased of women).--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 46, 2143 (º-Kaikeyaiḥ, protected Duryodhana); 47, 2229 (supported Duryodhana); 50, 2404 (ºāṇām īśvaraḥ, i.e. Śalya), 2408 (ºāṇām īśvare, i.e. Śalya); 56, 2762 (º-Saindhavān, attacked by Bhīmasena).--§ 610 (Śalyap.): IX, 7, 332 (ºāṇām adhipaḥ, i.e. Śalya).--§ 611 (do.): IX, 12, 617 (ºāṇāṃ vṛshabhaṃ Śalyaṃ); 13, 674 (ºāṇām adhipaṃ, i.e. Śalya); 15, 782 (do.), 784 (ºāṇām adhipasya, i.e. Śalya); 18, 957, 973, 984 (attack Yudhishṭhira after the slaughter of Śalya, but are slain by the Pāṇḍavas); 23, 1205 (ºyodhāḥ). Cf. Madraka, pl., Mādreya, pl.
Madra^2, pl. (ºāḥ). § 186 (Vyushitāśvop.): I, 121, 4714 (the dead Vyushitāśva begat on Bhadrā three Śālvas and four M.).
Madrādhipa^1 (“king of the Madras”) = Aśvapati: III, 16658, 16914 (Aº).
Madrādhipa^2 (do.) = Śalya, q.v.
Madrādhipati (do.), Madraja, Madrajanādhipa, Madrajaneśvara = Śalya, q.v.
Madraka, a prince. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2696 (reborn from the Krodhavaśa gaṇa).--Do.^2 = Śalya, q.v.

Madraka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Madra, pl. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 119 (ºāṇāṃ rājā, = Śalya?, waited upon Yudhishṭhira).--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 51, 2097 (protected Bhīshma).--§ 581 (do.): VI, 61, 2695 (ºānīkān Kekayāṃś ca), 2698 (pierced by Dhṛshṭadyumna).--§ 607 (Karṇap.): VIII, 40, 1836, 1838 (sg.), 1839 (sg.), 1840, 1844 (pl., sg.), 1845 (sg., pl.), 1847, 1848 (sg.), 1851 (sg.), 1857 (description of their evil practices); 45, 2078 (Gāndhāra-Mºāḥ), 2096, 2108, 2109 (sg.) (description of their evil practices).--§ 610 (Śalyap.): IX, 7, 329.-§ 611 (do.): IX, 8, 391 (followed Śalya); 18, 960 (Madrarājapriye yuktair Mºāṇāṃ mahārathaiḥ).--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 65, 2429 (Āndhra-Mºāḥ, enumeration of low peoples).--§ 664 (Mokshadh.): XII, 207, 7559 (in the south).
Madrakādhama, Madrakādhipa, Madrakeśvara = Śalya, q.v.
Madranābha, pl. (ºāḥ), name of a caste: XIII, 2585. Madrāṇām adhipa(ḥ), Madrāṇām īśvara(ḥ), Madrāṇām ṛshabha(ḥ), Madrāṇāṃ vṛshabha(ḥ) = Śalya, q.v.
Madranṛpānuja (“the younger brother of the king of the Madras” [i.e. Śalya]) = Śalyānuja.--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 17, 930. Cf. Madrarājānuja.
Madrapa, Madrapati, Madrarāj = Śalya, q.v.
Madrarāja^1, = Dyutimat: I, ††3832 (Dº).--Do.^2 = Śalya, q.v.--Do.^3 = Aśvapati: III, 16628.
Madrarājānuja = Madranrpānuja: IX, 924 (yuvā).
Madrarājasutā (“the daughter of the king of the Madras”) = Mādrī: I, 4896.
Madrarājātmaja (“the son of the king of the Madras”) = Rukmaratha(?).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 112 (had been slain by Abhimanyu).
Madrarājeśvarātmaja = Śalya, q.v.
Mādravatī^1, wife of Parikshit.--§ 160 (Pūruv.): I, 95, ††3837 (wife of Parikshit and mother of Janamejaya^1).
Mādravatī^2 = Mādrī: XIV, 1969 (ºyāḥ sutau, i.e. Nakula and Sahadeva).
Mādravatīputra (“the son of Mādravatī [i.e. Mādrī]”) = Sahadeva: XVII, 55.
Mādravatīputra (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: XIV, 389.
Mādravatīsuta^1 (do.) = Nakula: III, 15732, 15738; V, 2254 (Nº); XII, 6204; XV, †669 (jyeshṭhasya).
Mādravatīsuta^2 (do.) = Sahadeva: II, 1176, 2550 (Sº); VII, 7475; XV, †668 (yavīyasaḥ), 1075.
Mādravatīsuta (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: III, 16607; V, †5, †18, †724; IX, 814, 3318; XIV, †1533, 2081.
Madreśa = Śalya, q.v.
Madreśvara^1 (“the king of the Madras”) = the father of Mādrī [and Śalya]: I, 4367 (ºsya, sc. sutā, i.e. Mādrī).
Madreśvara^2 = Śalya, q.v.
Madreśvarasuta (the son of Madreśvara [i.e. Śalya]) = Rukmaratha: VII, 1811 (Rº).
Mādreya^1 (“son of Mādrī”) = Nakula: III, 17246, 17253; VIII, 963; XII, 6129, 6207.
Mādreya (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: I, 5647; III, 1123.
Mādreya, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Madra, pl.--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 346 (º-Jāṅgalāḥ).

Mādrī^1 (“the daughter of the Madra king”), the wife of Pāṇḍu and mother of Nakula and Sahadeva. § 132 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2794 (incarnation of the goddess Dhṛti).--§ 157 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, ††3811 (wife of Pāṇḍu), ††3816, ††3817 (by the Aśvins mother of Nakula and Sahadeva), †3818 (all. to § 192 foll.).--§ 177 (Pāṇḍudigvijaya): I, 113, 4430 (sister of Śalya), 4441, 4442, 4444 (Pāṇḍu married M.).--§ 178 (Pāṇḍu): I, 114, 4474, 4477 (Pāṇḍu went to the wood with his wives).--§ 180 (Gāndhārīputrotpatti): I, 115, 4484.--§ 184 (Pāṇḍu): I, 119, 4613, 4616 (cursed by Kindama, Pāṇḍu retired to the wood with his wives).-§ 192 (Pāṇḍavotpatti): I, 124, 4849, 4850 (at the wish of Pāṇḍu M. learnt the mantra from Kuntī and invoked the Aśvins, who on her begat Nakula and Sahadeva), 4859.-§ 193 (Pāṇḍu): I, 125, 4870, 4874, 4878, 4880, 4882, 4884, (4887), 4888, (4890) (Pāṇḍu's death).--§ 194 (do.): I, 126, 4922 (by the Aśvins mother of Nakula and Sahadeva), 4926 (had ascended the funeral pyre of Pāṇḍu).--§ 195 (do.): I, 127, 4932, 4933, 4934 (the pretakārya of Pāṇḍu and M. was performed), 4940, 4953.--§ 214 (Hiḍimbavadhap.): I, 156, 6097 (ºyāḥ, sc. putrau, i.e. Nakula and Sahadeva).--§ 305 (Anudyūtap.): II, 79, 2602.--§ 338 (Indralokābhigamanap.): III, 46, 1862 (yathā).--§ 522 (Draupadīharaṇap.): III, 266, †15607 (ºyāḥ putrau, i.e. Nakula and Sahadeva).-§ 548 (Āraṇeyap.): III, 313, 17416 (wife of Pāṇḍu), 17417. --§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 17, †871 (ºyāś ca putrau, i.e. Nakula and Sahadeva).--§ 618 (Jalapradānikap.): XI, 13, †359 (do., do.).--§ 795 (Svargārohaṇap.): XVIII, 4, 144 (with Pāṇḍu in heaven.). Cf. Madrarājasutā, Mādravatī.
Mādrī^2 (do.) = Vijayā, the wife of Sahadeva: I, ††3832 (Vº).
Mādrikā, pl. (ºāḥ) (“Madra women”).--§ 607 (Karṇap.): VIII, 40, 1853 (sg.), 1855 (pl.).
Mādrinandana^1 (“son of Mādrī”) = Nakula: IX, 764, (Nº).
Mādrinandana^2 (do.) = Sahadeva: II, 1116.
Mādrinandana (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: III, 19 (ºān (!)).
Mādrīnandanaka (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: III, 10856.
Mādrīnandikara (do.) = Sahadeva: V, 2000.
Mādrīsuta^2 (do.) = Sahadeva: II, 1163; V, 2868; VI, 5169; VII, 517, 7471, 8575; IX, †1558 (Sº), †1559 (slew Śakuni).
Mādrītanūja (do.), dual (ºau) = Nakula and Sahadeva: V, †688.
